title: Circ-ABCB10 knockdown inhibits malignant progression of cervical cancer
author: Feng, Zhang, et al.
materials: Siha, CaSki, and Hela cells were ordered from Cell Bank of Chinese Academy of Sciences (Shanghai, China). C33A, SW756 and normal human cervical epithelial cell (HUCEC) lines were obtained from American Type Culture Collection (ATCC; Manassas, VA, USA). CaSki cells were maintained in RPMI-1640 medium containing 10% fetal bovine serum (FBS). C33A, Siha and Hela cells were grown in Minimum Essential Medium containing 10% FBS. SW756 cells were maintained in Leibovitz’s L-15 medium containing 10% FBS in a 100% air incubator at 37 °C. Normal primary cervical epithelial cells were maintained in cervical epithelial cell basal medium (ATCC) added with the contents of cervical epithelial cell growth kit (ATCC). All cells except for SW756 cells were maintained in the incubator containing 5% CO2 at 37 °C. FBS and all CC cell medium were ordered from Thermo Scientific lnc. (Waltham, MA, USA).

steps.title: Obtain cell lines
steps.instruction: Order Siha, CaSki, and Hela cells from the Cell Bank of Chinese Academy of Sciences (Shanghai, China) and obtain C33A, SW756, and normal human cervical epithelial cells (HUCEC) from ATCC (Manassas, VA, USA).

steps.title: Culture CaSki cells
steps.instruction: Maintain CaSki cells in RPMI‑1640 medium supplemented with 10 % fetal bovine serum (FBS).

steps.title: Culture C33A Siha Hela
steps.instruction: Grow C33A, Siha, and Hela cells in Minimum Essential Medium (MEM) containing 10 % fetal bovine serum (FBS).

steps.title: Culture SW756 cells
steps.instruction: Maintain SW756 cells in Leibovitz’s L‑15 medium with 10 % fetal bovine serum (FBS) and incubate them in a 100 % air incubator at 37 °C.

steps.title: Culture normal cervical cells
steps.instruction: Maintain normal primary cervical epithelial cells in ATCC cervical epithelial cell basal medium supplemented with the ATCC cervical epithelial cell growth kit.

steps.title: Incubate cells under conditions
steps.instruction: Incubate all cell lines except SW756 in a humidified incubator at 37 °C with 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Prepare culture reagents
steps.instruction: Obtain fetal bovine serum and all cell culture media from Thermo Scientific (Waltham, MA, USA).

steps.title: Measure circ‑ABCB10 and miR‑128‑3p
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA from cells or tissues, synthesize cDNA, and quantify circ‑ABCB10 and miR‑128‑3p expression levels using quantitative real‑time PCR (RT‑qPCR).

steps.title: Statistical analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze data with GraphPad Prism software version 7.0, present results as mean ± standard deviation, and assess significance using Student’s t‑test or one‑way ANOVA with Tukey’s post‑hoc test; consider P < 0.05 as statistically significant.
